candidates.name: Geodetic data Grid eXchange Format (GGXF) Standard
verified_facts: GGXF defines a file format for regularly gridded geodetic parameters used in coordinate and height transformations.
Its intended uses include geodetic CRS transformations, vertical CRS transformations and geoid-related height reductions.
semantic_limits: A GGXF file is a carrier for transformation parameters; its presence does not prove that the correct regional grid, model version or interpolation was applied to a parcel result.

candidates.name: Well-known text representation of coordinate reference systems
verified_facts: WKT-CRS defines the structure and content of text strings describing coordinate reference systems and coordinate operations.
The standard describes CRS/operation definitions but does not prescribe implementation read/write behavior.
semantic_limits: A WKT string describes reference-system semantics; it is not evidence that a transformation was executed correctly and it does not carry all source provenance or measurement uncertainty.
